summary: Physician, lawyer and author of the standard History of Long Island (1839/1843); John's 3rd cousin 8x removed.
bio:
Path: John Thompson → Samuel → Jonathan → Dr. Samuel → Benjamin. Also 4C8R via Brewster (affected by the Brewster disproof) and probably 4C8R via Topping (his grandmother Mary Woodhull, b. 1711, appears to be a granddaughter of Temperance Topping). Called John Thompson 'the first Long Island ancestor of the compiler'.

Son of Dr. Samuel Thompson and his first wife Phebe Satterly ([R4-S1]); 3rd cousin 8 times removed via John Thompson. Irony worth telling: his own family account (the source used by earlier rounds) contains the two errors later disproved, the 1609 birth and the Mayflower Brewster wife for John Thompson.
sources: [R4-S1] B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), pp. 297-298 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historyoflongisl003thom
